title: Scrap Pirates Region Response V5
description: Defines durable regional world content for AI generation. Omit collections and optional fields when there is nothing meaningful to say; mission-specific characters, cargo, and transient story state belong in mission responses.

factions.description: Factions introduced by this region. Omit when the region introduces none.

systems.description: Star systems defined by this response.

locations.description: Dockable stations or landable ports. Omit when there are none.

equipmentDefinitions.description: Equipment definitions introduced by this region. Omit when there are none.

shipCards.description: NPC ship-card definitions introduced by this region. Omit when there are none.

decks.description: Weighted content decks introduced by this region. Omit when there are none.

id.description: Stable ID for this generated region document.

revision.description: Positive revision of this region document.

ModuleDeckBinding.description: Custom module deck for one faction affinity. Omit a color to use the host's default deck.

deckRef.description: ID of the module deck to use.

FactionRelation.description: Non-neutral starting relationship from one faction to another. Omit neutral relationships.

factionRef.description: Name of the faction this relationship points to.

stance.description: Starting stance toward the referenced faction.

Faction.description: A durable faction the AI DM can use for ownership, conflict, encounters, and world reactions.

name.description: Player-facing faction name; also used by factionRef fields.

affinity.description: Gameplay affinity/color. Blue often fits corporate factions, Yellow often fits sparrows, and Green often fits authoritarians or brigands; these are tendencies, not hard rules.

description.description: What the faction wants, how it behaves, and what makes interacting with it distinctive.

shipDecks.description: Custom ship deck IDs by class. Omitted classes use the host's default/fallback deck.

moduleDecks.description: Custom module decks by affinity. Omit colors that should use defaults.

relations.description: Explicit non-neutral relationships to other factions. Unlisted factions are Neutral.

secretInfo.description: Hidden motives, leverage, or truths available to the AI DM but not revealed by default.

hostileToPlayer.description: Initial hostility toward the captain. All ships of this faction share it; captain actions can additionally make a faction hostile. Default false.

friendlyToPlayer.description: Initially friendly to the captain; automatic support when joining a fight against a non-friendly side. Hostility overrides friendship. Default false.

stature.description: Narrative scale or role of the faction, such as local, civilian, minor, regional, or major.

hullDecks.description: Hull decks this faction may use.

System.description: Canonical facts for one generated star system.

controllerRef.description: Stable faction ID, not a display name.

minorRef.description: Stable faction ID, not a display name.

description.description: Concise canonical identity of the system: what would the local traders know about it?

callsign.description: Persistent story-assigned display label; identity and references use address.

hackedGate.description: Hidden gate capability. Do not reveal in public description or UI without the captain owning its password.

civilianRef.description: Civilian faction associated with the system, or null when none is defined.

Location.description: A dockable station or landable planet port inside a system.

description.description: What this place is, what happens here, and why a player might care about it.

services.description: Recognized services the player can access here. Omit when none are available.

appearance.description: Short visual brief for depicting the location.

hidden.description: Initially omitted from player navigation until RevealLocation.

restricted.description: Initially denies docking until SetLocationAccess Granted. Revelation does not grant access.

shots.description: Shots produced by one activation. Usually 1-4; higher damage generally means fewer shots.

baseDiceCount.description: Attack dice rolled per shot. Usually 1; very powerful cannons may use 2-3.

dieSides.description: Faces on each base attack die. Typical dice are d4, d6, d8, d10, d12, or d20. Balance die size against shots, dice count, and effects.

EquipmentDefinition.description: Immutable equipment definition available to ships or markets.

id.description: Stable ID used by deck entries and other references.

category.description: Broad equipment category used by catalogs and NPC system-slot draws. Economy modules are generally civilian/trading equipment rather than warship systems.

defense.description: Defense used by combat targeting/resolution. Delicate civilian equipment is often 1-3, cannons 3-5, and armor 5-7. Red modules might be 6-13 depending on their category.

inputs.description: Exactly three east-edge slots, top/middle/bottom. Colors must be distinct. With two inputs use [color, "", otherColor]. Invalid colors become empty; repeated colors are removed; two remaining colors move to top/bottom. Discard an inputless module. Reactors instead require [color,"",""] and place their one input at (0,1) West.

weapon.description: Weapon profile when this equipment is a weapon. Omit for non-weapons.

effects.description: Registered engine effects applied by this equipment. Omit when it has no special effects. Most non-red equipment has zero or one effect type, but some effect types are designed to be specified in multiple EquipmentEffect objects.

basePrice.description: Base market price before local modifiers.

SystemSlot.description: Generally a small ship has 2-3 of these, a medium one 4-5, and a large one 6 or more, but red slots are balanced at around twice as strong as other slots. The type of equipment that might be drawn is controlled by the faction's deck.

color.description: Affinity/color of equipment drawn for this slot.

FuelLoot.description: Fuel included in an NPC ship's loot profile.

quantity.description: Number of fuel tokens in this loot entry.

ShipCard.description: There are default ship cards as fallbacks for civilian use, but some factions are powerful or wealthy enough to have custom ship cards.

id.description: Stable ID used by ship decks.

class.description: Ship class, typically small, medium, large, or capital.

portraitBrief.description: Visual brief for the ship portrait.

coreDefense.description: Base defense of the ship core. Generally 2-4 for small or civilian ships, 3-5 for medium ships, and 6-10 for large ships.

systemSlots.description: Ordered outside-to-core system slots for NPC combat.

hullLootColors.description: Affinity colors used when resolving hull loot. Omit when there is no hull loot.

fuelLoot.description: Fuel loot associated with this ship card. Omit when there is none.

DeckEntry.description: Weighted entry in a generated content deck.

definitionRef.description: ID of the equipment definition or ship card drawn by this entry.

weight.description: Relative positive draw weight (number of copies in the deck.)

Deck.description: Weighted content deck referenced by factions or encounters.

id.description: Stable deck ID used by faction deck bindings.

kind.description: Definition category drawn by this deck - Ship or Module. Don't mix both Ships and Modules in one deck.

class.description: Ship class restriction for a class-specific deck. Omit when not class-specific.

entries.description: The actual contents of this deck.

DefinitionDeckBinding.description: Faction binding to a module or hull definition deck.

deckRef.description: Stable reference to another published record or definition.

ReactorDefinition.description: Fixed 3x5 reactor. inputs must be [color,"",""]; input is upper left. Above 3 cumulative output copies per round overloads the ship.

copies.description: One entry per die face; length equals sides. Above-range substituted values use the final entry.
